name: Methamphetamine
warning: High-dose / sleep-deprived presentation. Uses peripheral flicker. Photosensitivity note applies.
tierNotes: Threshold: extra crispness — the over-sharpened vigilant look (early sharpenHalo); snow near-deniable (VSS density is quadratic in weight).
Light: fine visual snow appears on flat surfaces — sparse salt-and-pepper specks shimmering at a fixed ~14 Hz, not per-frame static.

Common: slow granular texture-crawl in FLAT regions only (edges/objects hold still) + first peripheral shadow blobs that emerge from the scene's own dark, high-contrast corners and vanish when the mouse (gaze) approaches.

Strong: frequent image-driven shadow events, harsh contrast, cold desaturation, denser snow, plus 'vibrating vision' waking up — a fast constant eye-wiggle blur (PsychonautWiki's own documented high-dose meth effect, distinct from MDMA's episodic bursts) that reads as restless/wired rather than psychedelic.

Heavy: rare humanoid silhouettes (p≈0.025/s, Heavy only) against whichever frame edge is darker; constant crawl; full salt-and-pepper snowstorm; strong vibrating-vision blur; rare 'Transformations' flicker (p≈0.02/s, Heavy only) where a high-edge object briefly mis-samples itself — the uncanny 'that looked wrong for a second' read. Deliberately NOT psychedelic geometry/rainbow — PsychonautWiki's meth page doesn't document those as intrinsic effects.
